meta.name: coding.lower
meta.description: Coding-project L2 lower ontology — concrete subsystem classes (LSL, Constraints, Online learning, KM, ...) extending the L1 Component-hierarchy in coding-ontology.json

LiveLoggingSystem.description: Live Session Logging subsystem capturing time-windowed transcripts under .specstory/history/, including the ETM daemon and LSL resolver

ConstraintMonitor.description: Constraint monitor service on port 3030 that enforces project-level constraints (no-console-log, documentation-filename-format) and exposes a dashboard

OnlineObservation.description: Leaf-level observation artifact written by the online learning pipeline from a single prompt/response exchange

OnlineDigest.description: Daily roll-up of online observations into a digest artifact

OnlineInsight.description: Weekly synthesized insight artifact derived from online digests

KnowledgeManagement.description: Top-level knowledge subsystem comprising km-core, observations DB, JSON exports, and the Qdrant embedding sidecar

BatchSemanticAnalysis.description: Manual UKB wave-analysis pipeline (wave1/wave2/wave3 agents, persistence-agent, coordinator) — invoked via 'ukb full'

RapidLlmProxy.description: LLM routing surface on port 12435 with model-canonicalization, token-usage tracking, and per-process routing overrides

DockerizedServices.description: Docker-compose-managed services container (coding-services) hosting the dashboard, obs-api, lsl-resolver, semantic-analysis MCP server

EtmDaemon.description: Enhanced Transcript Monitor — launchd-managed com.coding.etm daemon under LiveLoggingSystem that watches transcripts and emits observations

BenchmarkHarness.description: kgbench / graphify-vs-grep code-retrieval benchmarking: run lifecycle, arms, agents, models, token attribution and reporting

AgentIntegration.description: Coding-agent integration seams — claude, copilot, opencode and pi launchers, headless invocation, model catalogues and per-agent capture

ExperimentFramework.description: A/B and cross-agent experiment runner — avenues, variants, KB-injection cells, judging, scoring and comparison reports

GsdWorkflow.description: GSD planning workflow — milestones, phases, plan/execute/verify skills and the .planning artefact tree

HealthDashboard.description: system-health-dashboard frontend and server.js API — observations, digests, insights, coverage and token-usage views

StatusLine.description: tmux status line and its click handlers — field rendering, width accounting, colour ramps and browser dispatch

CodeGraph.description: graphify code knowledge graph — indexing, incremental rebuild, ignore logic, corpus cache and the MCP query surface

TokenAccounting.description: token usage capture and cost attribution across agents and providers — wire differences, cache splits and reconciliation

OntologyAndViewer.description: ontology layout and the unified VKB viewer — upper/lower classes, entity levels, graph rendering and history panels

ContinuousIntegration.description: GitHub Actions CI — cross-platform runners, workflow definitions and host-assumption failures

DocumentationSystem.description: MkDocs documentation, PlantUML/Mermaid diagram generation and the documentation style guide

InstallAndBootstrap.description: install.sh and project bootstrap — dependency gating, agent scoping, feature resolution and first-run setup
